transients.method: Unweighted adjacent-sample first differences; a technical transient proxy.
Unweighted adjacent-sample first differences; a technical transient proxy.

candidate.signalPath: PCM16 source; unrounded Float64 interpolation/velocity/envelope, gain/pan automation and ordered track effects; Float64 sum, master gain/effects/ducking; single PCM24 quantization per export

alignment.method: Normalized cross-product over both channels; lag search -16..16 frames sampled every 32 frames. Positive lag means candidate is delayed. No correction applied.

residual.method: Candidate minus original at the same sample index and full-scale amplitude. No gain, delay, dither or mastering matching.

comparison.lowBandMethod: Two cascaded causal one-pole 150 Hz low-pass filters, continuous from sample zero; a mono-compatibility proxy, not a perceptual test.
comparison.interpretation: Differences quantify changed rounding and float processing through the unchanged authored mix. Measurements do not establish a subjective improvement.

timingAndContinuity.method: One continuous full-length renderer invocation per track/master, from sample zero; no independently reset section assembly. Boundaries are authored first-track clip starts. Adjacent deltas and crossing sources are diagnostics, not a perceptual seam certification.

reproducibility.scope: Byte equality on the recorded Node/FFmpeg/toolchain only. Original stored MP3 predates this toolchain; comparable listening copies are separately derived with the same encoder.

limitations: PCM16 sources retain their existing source resolution; newly calculated fractional detail survives to PCM24, but no lost source information is recovered.
Nonzero PCM24 low bytes are a diagnostic, not proof of source resolution or audible benefit; separate known-fraction precision tests establish correct processing and quantization.
Independently quantized post-track PCM24 stems need not sum byte for byte to the master, which sums original Float64 tracks before master processing.
No normalization or new mastering decisions are applied. True-peak/LUFS figures describe the unchanged authored mastering settings.
Cross-correlation, mono, boundary and transient measurements are engineering diagnostics. Human listening and release approval remain pending.
